description: The window hosts the Askwell web app over plain HTTP. `M7-TAURI-FE-182` grants exactly five commands to that one origin — three native dialogs and two filesystem reads scoped to whatever a dialog already returned (`AllowedRoots` in `src/main.rs`) — nothing else reaches Rust, which is still the shape C7 wants: content in the window stays data, and the only route to native capability is this named, narrow allowlist.
